request.prompt: A ten-second vertical independent magazine interview. Two adults in adjacent chairs, one in a pale blue shirt and one in a black jacket, exchange a glance and share a brief laugh. Keep both faces and both bodies within the same tall composition, with an unpatterned buff wall above and a clear dark rug below for future captions. Window light washes the side of the small theatre lounge. Film at seated eye height with a fixed camera. No letters or captions; quiet room sound. Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.
